# ImageFitly

> ImageFitly is a browser-based image utility site for resizing, compressing, converting and preparing images for online marketplaces and social platforms.

## Canonical site

- Homepage: https://tools.wezzik.com/
- Product guide and processing boundaries: https://tools.wezzik.com/product-guide.html
- Tool directory: https://tools.wezzik.com/#tools
- Blog: https://tools.wezzik.com/blog/

## What the site does

- Provides image size presets for Amazon, Shopify, Etsy, eBay, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X and Facebook.
- Provides browser-based resizing, compression and format conversion for common image files.
- Provides a background-removal tool whose model resources may need to load over the network.
- Does not require an account for the public tools.

## Important accuracy and privacy notes

- Routine resizing, compression and format conversion use browser-side processing for the selected image.
- Background-removal processing can load external scripts or model resources; this is not the same claim as saying that every feature is entirely offline.
- Output size, image quality and platform acceptance are not guaranteed for every file. Users should check the downloaded result and keep the original.
- For sensitive images, users should read the product guide and verify the current network and processing path before use.

## Related Wezzik products

- PDF tools: https://wezzik.com/
- Unit conversion: https://convert.wezzik.com/
- Image repair: https://wipeai.wezzik.com/
